state.paragraph: On August 1, 2016, Hinckley Allen provided Party B with a revised merger agreement and voting agreement, reflecting changes from the marked-up documents included with Party B's LOI. On August 3, 2016, Hinckley Allen provided G&W with a revised merger agreement and voting agreement, reflecting changes from the marked-up documents included with G&W's LOI. On August 3, 2016, the Company and Hinckley Allen also responded to additional due diligence questions submitted by Party B. On August 4, 2016, the Transaction Committee met by conference call to discuss the process with representatives of BMO and Hinckley Allen on the

adviser.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a financial or legal adviser is retained, engaged, terminated or first shown acting for the target, a committee or a bidder. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
